picks.title: GLM 5.2 beats Claude in our benchmarks
picks.why_it_matters: A Chinese model outperforming Anthropic's Claude in cybersecurity benchmarks signals the AI competitive landscape is shifting faster than expected, with implications for which foundation model bets will pay off.

picks.title: The pro-AI movement is splintering
picks.why_it_matters: National security-driven restrictions on AI model releases could create regulatory moats for compliant startups while slowing go-to-market for others—portfolio companies building on frontier models need to factor in potential deployment delays.

picks.title: The KIDS Act would require age checks to get online
picks.why_it_matters: Mandatory age verification legislation creates immediate market opportunity for identity/verification startups while threatening business models of consumer apps that rely on frictionless onboarding.
